about: Islands of the IAM Sequencing Atlas written in no healthy cell type: below 5 % methylated in all 58 types at >= 50 calls (island reference v0, 2026-11-20); each is one Law Sphere unit (UCSC hg19 island). A write here is a stray (the writer's rate 1/(1 + D) plus the meter); off_array marks islands no array probe covers. Measured. atlas_stray_by_type: each type's pooled methylated share over these islands in the atlas (measured healthy reference).
